description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.
The UID of the RD member account to remove.

description.zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For more information about regions and zones, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 将RD成员账号从堡垒机实例中移除（仅支持V3.2.48及以上版本使用）

descriptions.zh: 移除成员账号前，需先将堡垒机中所属该成员账号的ECS、RDS、PolarDB实例资产清除。
descriptions.en: Before removing a member account, you must purge the ECS, RDS, and PolarDB instance assets that belong to the member account from Bastionhost.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost remove-instance-rd-member --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --member-id 1597141696147832 --region cn-hangzhou
